description:
THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE OF INTENT TO AWARD A CONTRACT WITHOUT PROVIDING FOR FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION. THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION OR A REQUEST FOR COMPETITIVE PROPOSALS. 

DoDEA intends to award an Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract to small business, The Art of Education University, LLC UEI RME3BKX7W1488 to provide a K-12 Visual Arts Platform and a comprehensive bank of visual arts-specific asynchronous webinars and/or digital modules that will provide professional learning for visual arts educators. 

Please see the attached notice.
